Ironwood Remodels
OUR STORY

When Ethan Randle was honorably discharged from the United States Marines in 2014, he sought a new career that would be rewarding yet challenging. Initially, he was accepted into the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers apprenticeship. After about a year into his apprenticeship, he realized he needed a career that provided more internal gratification. From conversing with family and friends who were in general contracting, it seemed like a high possibility. The career offered an ability to make a real positive impact on customers daily lives. It also allowed him to challenge himself and to feel internally satisfied when a job was finished above expectations. It was then that he started working full-time under a general contractor in Orange County, Ca while simultaneously attending night school for a degree in construction technology.

The 7 Different Stages

Home remodels take time and money, and there are several steps to follow to ensure that your project runs smoothly, on time, and on budget.

We will show up on time everyday until the project is complete and we will be upfront and honest with you before, during and after the project. Our mission is to complete your project on time, within budget and exceeding all your expectations.

Our process is very easy, fast, and user-friendly to get started. You can get a free estimate by submitting our online Free Estimate request form, or you can reach out to us by email or just by giving us a quick call. Kitchens

The kitchen is one of the most lived-in rooms in your home. You make frequent trips to the kitchen, from your morning coffee, to a midnight snack. Our kitchen remodeling can increase the functionality of the space while also making it more attractive. This can range from new flooring and paint, all the way to a complete makeover with an all-new layout. Upgrade your storage with new cabinets, or replace an old countertop with something newer and more attractive. Whatever the goal, a kitchen makes a marvelous target for home remodeling.

Bathrooms

Next to the bedroom, the bathroom can be one of the most relaxing areas in your home. Lounging in a warm bath is even more enjoyable with a renovated bathroom. Our services can make your bathroom more functional and luxurious, providing the perfect blend between comfort and style. We can go simple, with new flooring, lighting, tubs, and showers, or vanities; or, completely transform the room, reconfiguring the layout to take better advantage of the space.

Home Additions

If you need more space but don’t want to move, we can help with building home additions. Perhaps instead of bathroom remodeling, you need a whole new bathroom. Home additions can also come in the form of bedrooms or other living areas. They can even expand the space in an existing room to create more space. Home additions need to be carefully designed by industry experts. The additions we build will match the current layout of your home while still providing you with the additional features you want.

Home Remodels

Sometimes, home remodeling isn’t limited to a specific room. Whole home remodels are an excellent opportunity to re-envision your home. They allow for extensive reconfiguration of the home’s layout that makes better use of the space available, and flows in a way that’s more conducive to your lifestyle. Our home remodeling services can provide you with a cohesive, attractive, and functional result that matches your desired style and fulfills your needs for the home

Specialty Rooms

Homeowners often find themselves with a spare room. Whether it’s the bedroom of a child who went off to college, to a guest room that never gets used, these spare rooms are ideal for repurposing. Specialty rooms such as home theaters, wine cellars, or home offices are common projects for our home remodeling team. The possibilities for these rooms are nearly limitless, as they can be customized to fit the specific needs of any hobby or profession. If you’re unsure exactly what you want or need, our team of experts can help you figure it out.

Outdoor Living

Some home remodeling projects take place outside of the home itself. The outdoors provides a great way to get some fresh air while relaxing or entertaining. Outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, seating areas, and more can be installed in custom patios or other outdoor living areas. Our team will work with you to design a space that matches your desired style, fits your needs, and complements your home’s existing exterior in a way that increases curb appeal and property value.

When you’re ready to take the next step in turning your home into a dream home, contact us to learn more about how we can help bring your vision to life. Job Description:
When this homeowner reached out, she knew her original 90s kitchen needed an upgrade, she just wasn’t sure where to start. With two teenage boys at home (one who loves to cook), the kitchen was a big part of daily life. Going without it during construction wasn’t easy, but she knew it would be worth it. After seeing the work we completed for her neighbor, she trusted Ironwood Custom Remodels to bring her vision to life. From design through construction, we worked through a few challenges along the way, but once everything came together, the transformation was incredible. The new kitchen now checks every box, beautiful countertops, soft-close cabinetry, improved storage, and warm under-cabinet lighting that brings the whole space to life. We also updated the guest powder room to tie everything together and elevate the home as a whole. Now, this family truly enjoys their space. Cooking, gathering, and making memories in a kitchen that finally fits their lifestyle, and they can’t imagine going back to what it was before.

Job Description:

When this husband and wife purchased their beautiful home in the historic Hope Valley community, they knew it had the potential to become their forever home, but it needed the right updates to get there.

Their first priority was transforming the entire first floor, starting with the kitchen. The existing layout felt dated and closed off, so we worked closely with Heather Holcombe Designs to reimagine the space from the ground up, moving structural walls, replacing windows with stunning Marvin units, and updating every detail along the way.

Together, we created a bright, open kitchen designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Featuring striking blue cabinetry, top-of-the-line Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, and plenty of space to gather, every element was carefully selected to bring their vision to life.

Now, their home feels completely transformed. What was once segmented and outdated is now a space they’re proud to show off, a kitchen where friends and family naturally come together, and where they truly feel at home.

Job Description:

When these homeowners reached out to Ironwood Custom Remodels, they had already completed their kitchen design with The Kitchen Specialist and were searching for the right contractor to bring it all to life. After meeting with a few teams, they sat down with us, and it felt like the perfect match from the start. They wanted a clean, high-end kitchen that felt warm, inviting, and built for entertaining, and that’s exactly what we love creating.

This “Legacy Kitchen” came together beautifully with light blue cabinetry run all the way to the ceiling, handmade tile backsplash throughout, and a stunning appliance package featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero, including a refrigerator/freezer and beverage cooler. Every detail was thoughtfully selected to create a space that feels both luxurious and welcoming, the kind of kitchen you can’t wait to cook in, gather in, and share with family and friends.

One of the most meaningful parts of this project was preserving the home’s history. The natural hardwood floors were originally milled from trees right on the property, and we were able to bring them back to life by resurfacing them, adding fresh beauty while keeping their story intact. By the end, these homeowners couldn’t have been happier, and we’re honored we got to help create a kitchen they’ll love for years to come.
